questions.question: Who among the following teamed up with flautist Hariprasad Chaurasia and guitarist Brij Bhushan Kabra and produced a concept album, ‘Call of the Valley’ (1967)?
questions.solution:
• Musician: Shivkumar Sharma
  • Instrument: He is credited with bringing the Santoor (a folk instrument) into Indian classical music.

questions.question: The word India came from the Indus, called ______ in Sanskrit.
questions.solution:
• Term: Sindhu
  • Etymology: The Greeks called it Indos, which eventually became India.

questions.question: Battle of Buxar was fought in ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1764
  • Parties: British EIC vs. Combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daulah, and Shah Alam II.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is correct with respect to the Prashastis and land grants?
I. Prashastis were composed by learned Brahmanas.
II. Kings often rewarded Brahmanas by grants of land which were recorded on copper plates.
questions.solution:
• Correct: Both I and II
  • Prashastis: These were glowing biographies of kings, while land grants recorded the transfer of property to priests.

questions.question: Who among the following headed the National Income Committee?
questions.solution:
• Chairman: PC Mahalanobis (1949)
  • Goal: To estimate the National Income of independent India.

questions.question: In which of the following years, did Subhas Chandra Bose refer to Mahatma Gandhi as the “Father of the Nation”?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1944
  • Context: Delivered in a radio address from Singapore while leading the INA.

questions.question:
Which of the following pairs of ‘Ruler - Ruling period’ is correctly matched?
I. Sher Shah Suri - 1540-1545
II. Akbar - 1556-1605
questions.solution:
• Correct Match: Both I and II
  • Timeline: Sher Shah Suri founded the Sur Empire; Akbar was the third Mughal Emperor.

questions.question: The Green Revolution in India started in _______________.
questions.solution:
• Start: 1960s
  • Pioneer: M.S. Swaminathan in India, introducing high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds.

questions.question: In 1498, Vasco da Gama, a Portuguese explorer had discovered a route to ______.

Which of the following statement is correct with respect to the Shaka dynasty?
I. Some kingdoms of Shakas lasted for about 500 years.
II. The Shakas were followed by the Kushanas about 2200 years ago.
questions.solution:
• Correct Match: Only I
  • Correction: The Kushanas followed the Shakas about 2000 years ago (not 2200).

questions.question: In 1653, which French scientist observed that if some pressure is applied to any point of an incompressible fluid, the same pressure is transmitted to all points of the fluid and to the walls of the vessel?
questions.solution:
• Scientist: Blaise Pascal
  • Law: Known as Pascal's Law, it is the fundamental principle of hydraulics.

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of the Kanva dynasty?
questions.solution:
• Founder: Vasudeva
  • History: He was a minister who overthrew the last Shunga king to start the Kanva dynasty.

questions.question: In 1873, the Satyashodhak Samaj was established in ____________.
questions.solution:
• Region: Bombay Presidency
  • Founder: Jyotirao Phule; it aimed at the liberation of Shudras and Dalits.

questions.question: The Paramhans Mandali was established to work for the abolition of caste in ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1840
  • Note: Its members took a pledge to ignore caste rules.

Which of the following cities became the capital of Bengal in 1704?
Babur ruled over Delhi till _____ year.
The bill which provide for the trial of British or European person by Indians was ______.
The duration of the Mesolithic period is from about ______ years ago to ______ years ago.
